description.title: Display and performance
text: Apple Watch Series 3 has a Retina OLED display with brightness up to 1000 nits.
The watch uses the S3 chip with a dual-core processor and the Apple W2 wireless chip.

description.title: Activity and sensors
text: An optical heart sensor supports heart-rate monitoring. An accelerometer and gyroscope provide motion data for activity tracking.
Built-in GPS supports location tracking, while the altimeter measures elevation.

description.title: Connectivity and charging
text: The watch supports 2.4GHz Wi-Fi and Bluetooth 4.2 for wireless connectivity.
A built-in rechargeable lithium-ion battery powers the watch. Charging uses a magnetic charging cable.

description.title: Display and performance
text: Apple Watch Series 6 has an Always-On Retina LTPO OLED display with brightness up to 1000 nits.
The watch uses the S6 chip with a 64-bit dual-core processor and the Apple W3 wireless chip.

description.title: Activity and sensors
text: Hardware includes optical and electrical heart sensors, a blood oxygen sensor, an accelerometer and a gyroscope.
Built-in GPS, a compass and an always-on altimeter support outdoor activity tracking.

description.title: Connectivity and charging
text: The watch supports both 2.4GHz and 5GHz Wi-Fi, along with Bluetooth 5.0 for wireless connectivity.
A built-in rechargeable lithium-ion battery powers the watch. Charging uses a magnetic charging cable.
